name: Securities Trade
definition: Specifies trades linked to securities operations such as the exchange of securities, the lending of securities and the transactions related to investment funds.

TradeAmount.name: Trade Amount
TradeAmount.definition: Total amount of the trade. Is equal to the executed trade quantity multiplied by the executed trade price.

OpeningClosingIndicator.name: Opening Closing Indicator
OpeningClosingIndicator.definition: Specifies additional information relative to the processing of the trade.

TradeTransactionCondition.name: Trade Transaction Condition
TradeTransactionCondition.definition: Indicates the conditions under which the order/trade is to be/was executed.

Activity.name: Activity
Activity.definition: Specifies the type of activity to which the trade relates.

TradeOriginationDate.name: Trade Origination Date
TradeOriginationDate.definition: Indicates the date and time of the agreement in principal between counter-parties prior to actual trade date.|Used with fixed income for municipal new issue markets.

ClearingFeeType.name: Clearing Fee Type
ClearingFeeType.definition: Indicates the type of fee for trade executions at an exchange.

TransactionType.name: Transaction Type
TransactionType.definition: Indicates the type of transaction of which the order is a component.

SecuritiesTransactionType.name: Securities Transaction Type
SecuritiesTransactionType.definition: Underlying information about the settlement transaction.

SecuritiesTradeRelatedIdentifications.name: Securities Trade Related Identifications
SecuritiesTradeRelatedIdentifications.definition: Specifies the different identifications associated with a securities trade.

SecuritiesTradeStatus.name: Securities Trade Status
SecuritiesTradeStatus.definition: Specifies the status of a trade.

TradeQuantity.name: Trade Quantity
TradeQuantity.definition: Specifies the total quantity of a financial instrument involved in a trade. It is derived from the ordered quantity or from the quantity specified in a leg of a financing agreement.

TradePrice.name: Trade Price
TradePrice.definition: Specifies the executed trade price which is derived from the different deal prices.

PartyRole.name: Party Role
PartyRole.definition: Specifies each role linked to a securities trade and played by a party at that step in a securities transaction flow.

SecuritiesFinancingClosingData.name: Securities Financing Closing Data
SecuritiesFinancingClosingData.definition: Financing process for which a closing leg is specified.

TradingExecution.name: Trading Execution
TradingExecution.definition: The realisation of the trade over one or more transactions.

TradeAllocation.name: Trade Allocation
TradeAllocation.definition: Information about the allocation of the trade.

RelatedOrder.name: Related Order
RelatedOrder.definition: Order which is executed by a trade.

SecuritiesFinancingOpeningData.name: Securities Financing Opening Data
SecuritiesFinancingOpeningData.definition: Financing process for which an opening leg is specified.
